collector.title: In-site Link Collector
collector.desc: Open an in-app browsing window that auto-scrolls to collect video links (Facebook supported)
collector.opened: Collector window opened. Please sign in and navigate to the target page.
collector.intro: Built for sites like Facebook profiles that require login and lazy-load their video lists. When yt-dlp cannot enumerate them directly, scroll to collect every video link in a real browsing window, then send them to batch download in one click.
collector.step1: Click "Open collector window", then sign in and go to the target page (e.g. a Facebook profile's Videos / Reels tab).
collector.step2: Click "Start" on the floating panel at the bottom-right. The script auto-scrolls and collects video links — do not interact with the page meanwhile.
collector.step3: Once the count looks about right, click "Send" on the floating panel anytime — it works while collecting and after you click "Stop". The links are sent back to this app.
collector.step4: Back on this page, click "Send to batch" and the links are filled into the Home batch mode.
collector.panelHint: Auto-scroll and collect video links on this page. Click "Send" anytime — during collection or after "Stop".
collector.logNoMore: No new videos for a while, stopped scrolling.
